summary: Captures Stereolabs ZED camera, SVO playback, or ZED network-stream image/depth data into TOP textures.

key_params.name: inputsource
key_params.note: USB camera, recorded SVO file, or network stream

key_params.name: cue
key_params.note: Cue SVO playback to the cue point

key_params.name: cueunit
key_params.note: Cue point units: indices, frames, or seconds

common_gotchas: ZED TOP is Windows-only and requires Stereolabs camera hardware/SDK support.
SVO File input behaves like a live ZED feed but camera settings are not applied in SVO mode.
Builds 2025.30000+ use ZED SDK v5.0.4, which no longer supports Pascal GPUs, GeForce 1xxx, or P-series Quadros.
Neural depth quality may take several minutes the first time while the SDK optimizes for the GPU.
Image mode changes the semantic meaning and channel layout of the TOP output.
Point cloud output is a 32-bit float RGB XYZ data image.
Mask output requires body tracking enabled through ZED CHOP.
ROI mask discards detections when more than half an object bounding box falls outside the mask.
Use ZED Select TOP, ZED CHOP, ZED POP, and ZED SOP to extract companion data for richer pipelines.
key_concepts: ZED TOP captures Stereolabs ZED camera, SVO/SVO2 playback, or network-stream image and depth data.
One ZED TOP outputs one selected image type; additional simultaneous outputs should use ZED Select TOP.
Depth, confidence, disparity, normals, point cloud, spatial texture, and mask outputs are data images with different channel meanings.
ZED TOP can pass camera image data onward to ZED POP and companion ZED CHOP/SOP workflows.
